name: Cascade Solar
old_description: We provide expert installation, custom system design, and trusted support for homes and businesses.
about:
Cascade Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Portland, Oregon. Founded by Tom Crowe and David Nicholls out of a personal commitment to solar energy, the business began after Crowe managed over 500 residential installations at a large regional solar firm and Nicholls brought more than a decade of experience as an electrician in the solar industry. The pair started the company together with the intention of staying small and growing at a sustainable pace.

The company provides custom solar system design, permitting, installation, activation, and ongoing maintenance for homes and businesses. Services include battery backup installation using equipment from FranklinWH, Tesla Powerwall, Enphase, and Sol-Ark, as well as real-time monitoring with production alerts and fault detection. Routine maintenance covers physical inspections, hardware checks, wiring, and performance reviews, all supported by a 10-year workmanship warranty.

Cascade Solar serves residential homeowners, commercial property owners, and multi-unit residential communities, including affordable housing projects. Notable projects include a 30 kW solar-plus-battery system for a complex Portland roof and a green apartment community installation. The company also offers financing guidance, incentive consultation, and personalized system sizing.

The founders emphasize honest pricing, quality craftsmanship, and a neighborly approach, encouraging customers to compare quotes. Their differentiation rests on a 10-year workmanship warranty, a commitment to never sacrifice core values for growth, and a focus on transparent, stress-free service from consultation through activation.
